units: Yalk. Gen. 151 מעי קוֹמְטִין עלי וכ׳ (Ar. קמתין, corr. acc.) my bowels curl themselves within me like a rope (cmp. קָמַז).—Part. pass. קָמוּט folded, creased.
<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 1:8">Tosef. Neg. I, 8</cite> <he>כק׳ שנפשט</he> like a folded sheet that has been straightened out.

<cite ref="Chagigah 14a:2">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 22:16">Job XXII, 16</cite> <he>קמטו</he>) <he>אלו … שמְקַמְּטִין עצמן וכ׳</he> that means the students that wrinkle themselves (cause wrinkles on their foreheads) over the words of the Law; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 908:10">Yalk. Job 908</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְקוּמָּט</he>. Tosef. Neg. l. c. <he>סדין המק׳</he> a creased sheet, v. <cite ref="Q02063"><he>פָּשַׁט</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chagigah 13b">Ḥag. 13ᵇ</cite> sq. (ref. to Job l. c.) <he>שקִימְּטוּ עצמן להיבראות וכ׳</he> Ms. M. 2 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) who pressed themselves (rushed) forward to be created before the world was created, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to be crowded, rushed. Ib. על אשר קוּמְּטוּ בלא עת Ms. M. because they rushed (to be created) before their time; Yalk. Jer. 304.—Part. מְקוּמָּט, v. supra.
